title: report1.v1
description: What the model writes for a full analysis (architecture 5.7, ADR-052; build step 7 decision D10): five keys and no others. There is NO direction field: the server copies bias, trend relation, rule and archetype from the synthesis reading. This is the SHAPE of lib/reply/contracts/report1.ts. The rules that need the packet (the zones, the cited ids and the placeholders must exist in it), the number of placeholders in a text (at most 8), the total of all texts (at most 2400 characters), the tag characters U+E0000 to U+E007F, and the specific FORBIDDEN_KEY report for a direction-like key are enforced by validateReport1 and are NOT expressed here. Lengths count Unicode code points here and UTF-16 code units there; they agree for text outside the astral planes.

plainText.description: One line of plain text: no control, line-separator, bidirectional embedding, override or isolate character, no byte order mark.

placeholders.description: A brace belongs to a well-formed {value id}, or the text is refused.
